skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Doctor of Faces
skins.content: 0011 New Arrivals/Doctor of Faces. Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, with a design concept more inclined towards the East, its main appeal is to highlight the wearer's personality. Onlookers can sense the simplicities and trends of Lungmen.
skins.quote: Medicine's a useful tool. How do you wanna use it?

skins.name: Healing Hand, Evil Heart
skins.content: 0011 New Arrivals/Healing Hand, Evil Heart. Handmade in Lungmen, the outfit includes multiple pieces of clothing that can be mixed and matched based on the customer's mood. The details in the outfit have been adjusted according to his needs, and includes an old-fashioned medicine box.
skins.quote: Practicing medicine is like spraying pesticide. It can uproot disease, or it can snuff out life. Life or death begins with the formula, ends with the dosage, and depends entirely on intent.
